# LIMCARS test fixture — HAND-AUTHORED, not a live capture.
# SGLang was not installed on the audit box, so these samples were written from
# the metric family names in app/dialects.py SGLANG plus SGLang's documented
# sglang:* naming. They therefore verify *internal* consistency (the dialect
# parses, label-matches and invariants hold) but cannot prove upstream truth the
# way tests/fixtures/vllm_metrics.txt does. Replace with a recorded capture from
# a real SGLang build as soon as one is available.
# TYPE sglang:num_running_reqs gauge
sglang:num_running_reqs 3
# TYPE sglang:num_queue_reqs gauge
sglang:num_queue_reqs 1
# TYPE sglang:token_usage gauge
sglang:token_usage 0.42
# TYPE sglang:prompt_tokens_total counter
sglang:prompt_tokens_total 1250000
# TYPE sglang:generation_tokens_total counter
sglang:generation_tokens_total 240000
# prefill_tokens is label-matched on mode="prefill*" — the trailing * is a
# prefix match, so this fixture also pins that behaviour, not just the name.
# TYPE sglang:realtime_tokens_total counter
sglang:realtime_tokens_total{mode="prefill"} 1250000
sglang:realtime_tokens_total{mode="decode"} 240000
# TYPE sglang:cached_tokens_total counter
sglang:cached_tokens_total 800000
# TYPE sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds histogram
sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 40
sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 90
sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 100
sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum 22.5
sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_count 100
# TYPE sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds histogram
sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{le="0.01"} 5000
sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 5000
sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum 30.0
sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_count 5000
# TYPE sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds histogram
sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="1"} 20
sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 100
sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum 610.0
sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count 100
# TYPE sglang:queue_time_seconds histogram
sglang:queue_time_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 60
sglang:queue_time_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 100
sglang:queue_time_seconds_sum 12.0
sglang:queue_time_seconds_count 100
